text:
Alice Chen: Heads-up — I'll be OOO Fri–Sun, need to swap primary for the weekend night shift. Proposed window: Sat 22:00 UTC -> Sun 06:00 UTC. Ben, can you take primary? Carol as secondary? There's a scheduled infra maintenance that might overlap ~02:30–03:15 UTC; we need explicit coverage for that gap. Also leaving a short handoff checklist and runbook pointers below.

Ben Rodriguez: I can take primary for that window. Quick Q: do we want a hard overlap (30m) before handoff or soft? Also what's the exact maintenance scope?

Alice Chen: Thanks Ben. Soft overlap is fine but I'd prefer 15m minimum to sanity-check canaries. Maintenance is infra team rolling kernel patches + a canary restart on the inferencing pool (only canaries should be restarted). Dave is running it — tagging him here.

Dave Li: Confirmed maintenance window is Sat 02:30–03:15 UTC. Scope: kernel patches on a subset of nodes (no model pushes). We'll run a canary restart job `infra/canary-restart` first, monitor latency for 15m, then continue if stable. I will post start/finish in #incidents when kicking off.

Carol Park: I'm available as secondary. If a page is P1 (customer-facing 5xx spike) and primary isn't responding, promote secondary by calling escalation policy and updating the rotation in the console. Do we have the exact promote steps in the oncall runbook?

Alice Chen: Yes — runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (internal). Copying minimal promote steps here so you don't need to open the link mid-page: 
```
1) Acknowledge page in PagerDuty/console
2) Run `redwood status list --service inferencing` to check model endpoints
3) If >50% 5xx or latency >3x baseline, run `redwood promote --role secondary --to primary` (this triggers traffic shift to dedicated fallback pool)
4) Notify #product and #support with `@here` and short summary
5) Open incident doc: /incidents/new and attach logs
```

Ben Rodriguez: Good checklist. For the promote step, what's the expected user-visible impact? How long does the traffic shift take?

Alice Chen: Traffic shift is typically ~45–90s for routing changes + warmup. Models in fallback pool are slightly smaller quantized variants (cost-efficient) — expect mild quality variance. Always call out `expected degradation` to support when it's customer-facing.

Erin O'Neill: I can cover the maintenance overlap (02:15–03:30 UTC). I'm local and can keep eyes on the canaries. If anything pagers, I'll escalate to Ben (primary).

Ben Rodriguez: Awesome — Erin covering overlap solves my travel conflict. Thanks Erin. I'll still be on-call primary and reachable except for a 15m commute window 23:45–00:00 UTC; I'll set a buddy-check reminder at 23:30.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Scheduled maintenance notice: infra/canary-restart planned for 2028-03-16 02:30 UTC in region us-west-2. Affected services: inference-serving-canary. Pager rules unaffected.

Alice Chen: Hand-off checklist (paste this into the rotation notes before you leave):
- Confirmed primary: Ben Rodriguez (1848001234 -> 1848004567)
- Confirmed secondary: Carol Park
- Overlap coverage: Erin O'Neill 02:15–03:30 UTC for canary monitoring
- Maintenance: Dave Li executing 02:30–03:15 UTC (monitor canary latency + errors)
- Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff
- Escalation: pager -> 15m ack expectation -> escalate to SRE lead if no ack

Ben Rodriguez: I'll update the rotation notes and set a calendar block and PagerDuty override for the window. Leaving a quick command cheat-sheet for the night: 
```
# check current incidents
redwood incident list --state open

# quickly tail model logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-serving -c runtime --since=10m | tail -n 200

# promote secondary (dry-run flag available)
redwood promote --role secondary --to primary --dry-run
```

Carol Park: One thing to flag — support flagged a customer test harness that runs heavy batched inference at 02:45 UTC. If that's true, we should coordinate with Support to pause it for the maintenance window. @support FYI.

Alice Chen: Good catch. @support-team — can you please pause the scheduled test at 02:45 UTC for Sat maintenance?

Erin O'Neill: Support confirmed: paused. They posted in the support queue.

Ben Rodriguez: Final confirmation: I accept primary, Carol accepts secondary, Erin covers overlap, Dave executes maintenance. I'll add a quick note to the incident channel 15m before maintenance to remind the team.

Alice Chen: Thank you all — leaving the thread in your hands. If anything critical happens while I'm gone, I've delegated incident lead to Ben. :pray: 

Dave Li: I'll ping here at start/finish of the maintenance. If canary latency >2x baseline for 15m, I'll abort and roll back.

IncidentBot: :information_source: Reminder scheduled: post to #incidents 15m before 02:30 UTC (scheduled by Ben Rodriguez).

Ben Rodriguez: Got it. I'll set the reminder and calendar and toggle the PD override. Everyone good?

Carol Park: Good from me.

Erin O'Neill: Good from me.

Alice Chen: Thanks team — have a smooth weekend. :sun_with_face:
